newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti rules out capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti rules out capital increase.

text.p: Troubled high-tech group Olivetti does not plan a capital increase but seeks to achieve "financial equilibrium" through divestments to be carried out this year and next, chief executive Roberto Colaninno said.

"The priority is the company's financial equilibrium," he told a meeting of financial analysts here. "The solution is not through a capital increase, this is a hypothesis which does not arise, but internal solutions must be found which take jobs into account - above all divestments to take place between 1996 and 1997," he said.
